description: Branch protection for main — require PR, status checks, conversation resolution. Apply via gh api.
alternative_gh_command: gh api repos/rubyrayjuntos/hermes-memory/branches/main/protection -X PUT -F required_status_checks[strict]=true -F required_status_checks[contexts][]='property tests (py3.11)' -F required_status_checks[contexts][]='property tests (py3.12)' -F required_status_checks[contexts][]='integration (pgvector service)' -F enforce_admins=true -F required_pull_request_reviews[required_approving_review_count]=1 -F required_pull_request_reviews[dismiss_stale_reviews]=true -F required_pull_request_reviews[require_code_owner_reviews]=false -F required_conversation_resolution=true --silent
